title: API Docs
subtitle: Every way to talk to this server — documented as it actually behaves.

quickstart.title: Quick start
quickstart.body: The server speaks the OpenAI chat format on `/v1/chat/completions`. Point any OpenAI-compatible client at `http://<host>:<port>/v1` and it works. Streaming uses server-sent events (`data: {json}` lines, terminated by `data: [DONE]`).

anthropic.title: Anthropic-compatible
anthropic.body: `POST /v1/messages` mirrors the Anthropic Messages shape for clients that prefer it.

native.title: Native generate (SSE)
native.body: `POST /v1/generate` returns a single completion; with streaming it emits tokens over SSE. Errors are reported in-stream rather than as a separate HTTP status.

websocket.title: WebSocket streaming
websocket.body: A WebSocket stream path exists in the server source, but it is NOT described by the OpenAPI schema and is not a stable contract yet. Prefer the HTTP SSE endpoints above. If you use the socket, cancellation is by disconnect.

ide.title: IDE integration
ide.body: Any tool that accepts an OpenAI base URL (Cursor, Continue, Claude Code, etc.) can use this server. Set the base URL to `http://<host>:<port>/v1` and pick any model id that is currently loaded.

models.title: Models API
models.body: Scan folders for GGUF files, then load / unload / reload by id. `/v1/models/scan` can take a while on large model stores.

issues.title: Issues API
issues.body: Full report lifecycle with a 9-state machine. Status changes are validated against a transition matrix; marking an issue `fixed` requires `root_cause`, `fix_summary` and `verify_steps`, and then auto-advances to `verify_pending`.

server.title: Server info
server.body: Live version, host and port are read from the running server. The full interactive schema lives in Swagger.

honestNotes.reasoningEffort: `reasoning_effort` is accepted and echoed back, but the server does not act on it yet — it has no effect on generation.
honestNotes.tools: `tools` is accepted for compatibility but the server does not execute tool calls yet.
honestNotes.anthropicStream: On the Anthropic-compatible streaming path the prompt is sent as plain text (a discovered quirk) — keep that in mind when adapting clients.
honestNotes.websocket: The WebSocket route is not in the OpenAPI schema and is not a stable contract — prefer HTTP SSE.

lifecycle.title: Issue lifecycle
lifecycle.body: open → triaged → in_progress → fixed → (auto) verify_pending → verified → (auto) closed. `wontfix` / `duplicate` may close directly; verification failure reopens as in_progress.
